normal.text: I am a little shocked how much attention is on the release of that new version of that #crimeGame right now. What is the appeal of having to do crimes in a game? I’m not saying that makes people mass murderers. I just don’t understand why. When I go my #SteamDeck a few years ago, I decided to avoid any games that feature wars, combat or fights. I may be extreme in this regard, but it feels right.

normal.name: Bill Hunt
normal.text: Winter Burrow was my favorite cozy #videogames last year, about a little mouse running around helping their friends while trying not to freeze, announced a new DLC. Friends, I think fishing minigames are the absolute *worst* thing in modern gaming. The fact that every single game feels the need to shoehorn in a half-baked collection mechanic that adds nothing to the gameplay just enrages me. The new *paid* DLC? It's *only* adding a fishing minigame. This feels like such a betrayal.
